docs.title: DesignBuilder Schema
docs.text: Python package for reading, editing, and writing DesignBuilder XML simulation files using Pydantic v2 and pydantic-xml.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: pip install designbuilder-schema

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
from db_schema.utils import load_model, save_model

# Load a DesignBuilder XML file
model = load_model("path/to/model.xml")

# Inspect geometry
for building in model.site.buildings.building:
    for block in building.building_blocks.building_block:
        for zone in block.zones.zone:
            print(zone.body.vertices.point_3d)

# Save back to XML
save_model(model, "output.xml")

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Type-safe XML parsing via Pydantic v2 and pydantic-xml
  • Full DesignBuilder schema support: geometry, surfaces, openings, HVAC
  • Round-trip load → modify → save fidelity
  • Thread-safe handle generation
  • LRU caching for repeated loads

class dsbXML(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True)

    name: str = attr()
    date: datetime.date = attr()
    version: str = attr()
    objects: str = attr()
    site: Site | None = element(tag="Site", default=None)

    @classmethod
    def from_xml(cls, source: str | bytes) -> dsbXML:
        from lxml import etree

        if isinstance(source, (str, bytes)):
            root = etree.fromstring(source)
        else:
            root = source

        instance = super().from_xml_tree(root)
        return instance

    def to_xml(self, **kwargs) -> str | bytes:
        from lxml import etree

        xml_output = super().to_xml(**kwargs)
        if isinstance(xml_output, bytes):
            root = etree.fromstring(xml_output)
            root.tag = "dsbXML"
            return bytes(
                etree.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8")
            )
        else:
            root = etree.fromstring(xml_output.encode())
            root.tag = "dsbXML"
            return str(
                etree.tostring(
                    root, xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8"
                ).decode("UTF-8")
            )

class HVACComponents(BaseModel):
    hvac_component: list[HVACComponent] = element(tag="HVACComponent", default_factory=list)

    @field_validator("hvac_component", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def recast_components(cls, components):
        if not isinstance(components, list):
            components = [components]
        result = []
        for component in components:
            if isinstance(component, dict):
                comp_type = component.get("type", "")
                result.append(HVAC_COMPONENT_MAPPING.get(comp_type, HVACComponent)(**component))
            else:
                result.append(component)
        return result

class Point3D(BaseModel):
    value: str = "0;0;0"

    @field_validator("value", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _coerce_empty(cls, v):
        """Treat empty or whitespace-only text as the origin sentinel."""
        if not v or not str(v).strip():
            return "0;0;0"
        return v

    def _parse_coords(self) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
        parsed = tuple(float(c) for c in self.value.split(";"))
        if len(parsed) != 3:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected 3 coordinates, got {len(parsed)}: {self.value!r}")
        return parsed

    @property
    def x(self) -> float:
        return self._parse_coords()[0]

    @property
    def y(self) -> float:
        return self._parse_coords()[1]

    @property
    def z(self) -> float:
        return self._parse_coords()[2]

    @property
    def coords(self) -> list[float]:
        return list(self._parse_coords())

    @property
    def is_zero(self) -> bool:
        """True when all coordinates are zero — the sentinel for 'no position'."""
        return self.value == "0;0;0" or all(c == 0.0 for c in self._parse_coords())

    def __setattr__(self, name: str, value: float | list[float]) -> None:
        if name == "coords":
            if isinstance(value, list) and len(value) == 3:
                self.value = ";".join(map(str, value))
            else:
                raise ValueError("Coordinates must be a list of 3 numbers")
        elif name in ["x", "y", "z"]:
            index = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}[name]
            coords = self.value.split(";")
            coords[index] = str(value)
            self.value = ";".join(coords)
        else:
            super().__setattr__(name, value)
